create_SLModule: create an SLModule instance with an encoder, task model, optimizer config, and optional checkpoint paths
load_task_from_checkpoint: load a task decoder model from a checkpoint file into the SLModule using load_task
load_encoder_from_checkpoint: load an encoder from a JEPa or DINO checkpoint into the SLModule using load_encoder
configure_optimizers_with_scheduler: configure optimizers with weight decay groups and an optional learning rate scheduler for training
freeze_encoder_for_finetuning: freeze the encoder by setting train_encoder to False so only the task model is trained
